result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: broken thumbnail scaling on Green Bowl Poké card and inconsistent favorite-icon styling in Popular section.

issues.description: First card in 'Fastest near you' (Green Bowl Poké) shows a small centered dish on a large empty light-gray background while adjacent cards are full-bleed images, looking like broken image scaling or missing image.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent cover/fill treatment and aspect ratio for all carousel thumbnails so images fully fill the card

issues.description: Favorite heart icon on Tokumaru Ramen Bar image has no background scrim and appears as white outline directly on image, while the pizza card below uses a dark circular background, creating inconsistency and low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same dark circular scrim background to all favorite icons for consistency and legibility
